title: Milne’s rationality conjecture and algebraic specialization

result.label: Milne’s rationality conjecture and algebraic specialization
result.statement: Proves Milne's rationality conjecture for abelian varieties over Q with good reduction: specialized Hodge classes pair rationally with complementary divisor products, independently of cohomology theory. Together with result 032, every specialized Hodge class is represented by a single rational algebraic cycle simultaneously in all prime-to- p and crystalline realizations, for every residue characteristic p .
